_meta.description: Every AM/FM station that a tracked game is carried on in the San Francisco Bay Area, focused on the Outer Sunset (94122). Includes wider-scope stations (KGMZ 95.7 for Warriors/Valkyries) and a documented exclusion (Sharks Audio Network: streaming only). Reception notes are deliberately conservative: only facility facts read from a source are asserted; anything unverified is marked NEEDS_MANUAL_CHECK.
_meta.why_this_matters: A game counts as busy only if it is reachable on a standard radio. This file is the audit trail for that assumption.
_meta.regulatory_note: County-by-county AM/FM reception cannot be proven from documents. Nothing here claims a measured field strength; see docs/LIMITATIONS-NEXT.md.
